acceptance_criteria.criterion: convertResponses() includes a '403' key in the returned array when the method implements APIKeyMethodInterface.
convertResponses() does NOT include a '403' key when the method does not implement APIKeyMethodInterface.
The @return PHPDoc uses '403'?: (optional key) to prevent PHPStan type mismatches.

summary: Added HTTP_403 = '403' constant to ResponseConverter.
Added use statement for APIKeyMethodInterface in ResponseConverter.
Updated @return PHPDoc on convertResponses() to include '403'?: optional key in the shape type.
Added conditional branch in convertResponses() that appends a 403 error response when the method implements APIKeyMethodInterface, describing ERROR_METHOD_NOT_GRANTED and ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_RIGHTS.
Added createKeyMethodMock() helper to ResponseConverterTest for mocks implementing APIKeyMethodInterface.
Extended test_httpConstants_haveExpectedValues to assert HTTP_403 = '403'.
Added test_key_method_includes_403_response and test_non_key_method_excludes_403_response to ResponseConverterTest — both pass (22 tests, 58 assertions total).

Fixed pre-existing PHPStan @return $this error on ErrorResponse::makeForbidden() (introduced by WP-001) — removed the erroneous annotation to match the pattern of makeBadRequest() and makeInternalServerError().
PHPStan passes cleanly with no errors.

comments.note: ErrorResponse::makeForbidden() (ErrorResponse.php ~L155) had a @return $this PHPDoc annotation that was incompatible with setHTTPStatusCode() returning self. PHPStan flagged this as a type error. The annotation was not present on the sibling methods makeBadRequest() and makeInternalServerError() — it appears to have been added by WP-001 but was never needed. Removed to restore consistency and fix the PHPStan failure.

ResponseConverter::convertResponses() now builds $responses as a mutable array and conditionally appends the 403 entry. A small improvement to consider: the 403 description text concatenates APIMethodInterface integer constants inline (e.g. 183005). If the description format is ever revisited for localisation or richer documentation (e.g. using error code names rather than raw integers), the string could be extracted to a private helper or a constant string. No action required now.

convertResponses() appends '403' key when method implements APIKeyMethodInterface (AC2); omits it otherwise (AC3).
@return PHPDoc uses '403'?: optional-key shape preventing PHPStan type mismatches (AC4).
test_key_method_includes_403_response and test_non_key_method_excludes_403_response both pass (AC5, AC6).
Full ResponseConverterTest suite: 22 tests, 58 assertions, 0 failures (AC7 for tests).
PHPStan: 2143 files analysed, 0 errors — clean (AC7 for static analysis).
ErrorResponse::makeForbidden() fix (removed erroneous @return $this) confirmed: method signature now matches sibling methods makeBadRequest() and makeInternalServerError().
APIKeyParameterTest::test_selectKeyManually failure confirmed to be the pre-existing WP-003 regression already documented in WP-003's prior QA FAIL pipeline; not caused by WP-004 changes.

comments.note: ResponseConverter.php L55-60: The 403 description text embeds raw integer constants from APIMethodInterface (183005, 183006) inline. If the error-description format is ever revisited for richer documentation, extracting the description text to a private helper or named constant would improve maintainability. No action required now.

summary: Reviewed ResponseConverter.php, ResponseConverterTest.php, and ErrorResponse.php.

Implementation is architecturally sound: HTTP_403 constant follows the existing HTTP_* naming pattern; the instanceof APIKeyMethodInterface check is the correct idiomatic PHP pattern for conditional response inclusion; the @return PHPDoc shape type with '403'?: (optional key) is precise and PHPStan-correct.
Interface hierarchy confirmed: APIKeyMethodInterface extends APIMethodInterface — the createKeyMethodMock() stub correctly satisfies the convertResponses(APIMethodInterface) parameter contract.
Error constants ERROR_METHOD_NOT_GRANTED (183005) and ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_RIGHTS (183006) are correctly sourced from APIMethodInterface in the description text.

ErrorResponse::makeForbidden() fix is clean: removing the erroneous @return $this annotation restores consistency with makeBadRequest() and makeInternalServerError(); the new docstring with @see references is informative.

Test coverage for the new 403 logic is correct: test_key_method_includes_403_response and test_non_key_method_excludes_403_response use assertArrayHasKey / assertArrayNotHasKey against isolated PHPUnit stubs — no bootstrap dependency.
No blocking issues, no fix-forward items. Code is clean and maintainable.

comments.note: [documentation-forward] test_key_method_includes_403_response only asserts the presence of the '403' key. A future improvement would be to also assert the structure of the 403 response (description field present and non-empty, schema $ref pointing to SCHEMA_API_ERROR_ENVELOPE) — consistent with the existing test_400response_schemaReferencesApiErrorEnvelope and test_500response_hasDescription patterns. Not required to pass — the current test fully satisfies the AC — but it would make the 403 test as thorough as its siblings.

ResponseConverter::convertResponses() L55-60: The 403 description embeds raw integer constants (183005, 183006) via string concatenation of APIMethodInterface::ERROR_METHOD_NOT_GRANTED / ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_RIGHTS. The description is clear and functional. If the format is ever revisited for richer OpenAPI docs, replacing the integers with their symbolic names (e.g. 'ERROR_METHOD_NOT_GRANTED') or extracting the string to a private constant would improve discoverability for API consumers reading the spec. No action required now.
